summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Lunch/Dinner session selector + human-readable date format in EventRegistrationModal. Tested WTWE supper-club page, WTWE menu page, single-event modal (homepage About), full end-to-end booking (form -> payment -> confirmed) on Sep 11 dinner, mobile 390px layout, and site-wide dash scan. All 6 requested scenarios PASSED. Test registrations were cleaned up via admin API (seats restored to 0).

minor.issue: Legacy event docs still contain em-dashes: 'Barsaat — Third/Second/First Table', 'Naani Ghar — Edition VI', time '19:15 — 22:00' (ids aa8def91..., 4d790a4f..., cdaf83ef..., e37cc057...). The dash_cleanup_events_v1 migration only patched _WTWE_EVENTS and _BARSAAT_AUG_EVENTS. Not visible on public pages tested (they are past events), but will show in admin dashboard / any past-events listing.

issues: About.jsx uses list[0] from GET /events?upcoming=true which is returned newest-last-date-first, so the pre-selected single event is the FURTHEST date (Sep 13 lunch) instead of the nearest upcoming date (Aug 23). Cosmetic/UX, consider sorting ascending before picking.

action_items: Optional: extend dash cleanup migration to legacy Barsaat/Naani Ghar event docs (em-dash in title/time) so admin views are dash-free.
Optional: pick nearest upcoming date (ascending sort) for single-event modals on homepage About / Suppers.
critical_code_review_comments: EventRegistrationModal.formatEventDate/sessionOf logic is correct; sessionOf falls back to parseInt(time) hour which works with the new 'HH:MM to HH:MM' format.
Session toggle is correctly gated on sessionTypes.length > 1 so single-event modals keep the read-only formatted date input.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 temp registrations (TEST QA Dinner, TEST QA Done) on wtwe-2026-09-11-dinner; both deleted via DELETE /api/registrations/{id}; seats_booked back to 0 for all WTWE events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: session toggle appears before Preferred Event Date, Lunch default selected, lunch options = ['August 23, Sunday · 8 left','September 6, Sunday · 8 left','September 13, Sunday · 8 left'], dinner options = ['August 30, Sunday · 8 left','September 11, Friday · 8 left'], selection auto-resets to first dinner date and modal header/venue/time update ('Abhāv Ke Bhāv, Dinner (Aug 30)', '19:00 to 22:00'). POST /api/events/wtwe-2026-09-11-dinner/register fired with correct event_id; payment step and confirmed step both show 'September 11, Friday' (no ISO, no dashes). Same behaviour on /menus/when-there-wasnt-enough. Barsaat page 'RESERVE THIS DATE' button is disabled (no upcoming Barsaat events -> selectedEvent null) - appears intentional, not retested. Single-event modal validated via homepage 'about-join-table'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found in the tested change.
